content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

- The relevant clause requires the contractor to perform any additional services requested by the client at no extra charge. This would obligate the contractor to do extra work without compensation. I propose that the clause be revised to state that additional services will be performed only under a written change order that specifies the scope and applicable fees.
- The relevant clause allows the client to request unlimited revisions until fully satisfied with each deliverable, which could lead to unbounded work without additional payment. I suggest limiting revisions to three rounds per deliverable, with any extra revisions requiring a separate written agreement and additional fees.
- The relevant clause lists an unlimited revision allowance, meaning the contractor could be required to make endless changes. I recommend changing this to allow up to three revisions per deliverable.
- The relevant clause states that requests outside the defined post‑launch support scope are treated as part of the Services, which would obligate the contractor to perform extra work without extra compensation. I propose that any work outside the scope be addressed only via a written change order and may incur additional fees.

Thanks for your understanding.
